replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design confirms email-only signup and $10 dual credit; concrete mass farming attack on credit budget."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design names referral codes; enumeration/guessing of codes to redeem against strangers is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: replaying or stacking redemptions on one account against the credit grant described."},{"id":"T4","keep":false,"reason":"Same attacker signing up own referral code with new email for same credit harm as T1.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Email-only sign-up quoted; account enumeration is a distinct disclosure harm to real users."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Design names real-money credit grant at unauthenticated sign-up; missing redemption attribution is specific, not generic."}]}
